pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Saint Peter Preaching — the apostle stands on a low ledge at the left in a blue robe with a heavy orange mantle falling from his shoulder to his bare feet, his white hair and short white beard catching the light and a thin gold ring round his head, one hand lifted open at the height of his face as he speaks and the other holding the cloth at his hip, a press of listeners crowded in front of him and up both sides, women kneeling closest in dark blue and rose with their hands at their cheeks and an old man in red bowed down beside them, young men in caps and hoods packed behind with their faces turned up, two figures in white and deep green standing at the right edge, a green wooded hillside rising steeply behind the whole group, then jesus called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and power to cure diseases, and he sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of god and to heal the sick
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_saint_peter_preaching

pictures.scene: Koninck, Panorama with Cottages along a Road — a wide flat country is seen from a rise with a sandy cart road running up out of the bottom corner and bending away through the fields, two tiny travellers walking along it far below with their packs, a thatched cottage with a broken roof standing right at the near edge of the road and a cluster of farm buildings with red tiles just beyond, dark hedges and orchards filling the middle distance, a broad pale river winding across behind them with a town and a church tower on its bank and small sails on the water, low hills and more villages fading out at the far horizon, and a heavy grey sky of worked cloud standing over the whole plain with a brighter break low down near the land, take nothing for the journey, he told them, no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic, whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that area
pictures.name: pd_koninck_vergezicht_met_hutten_aan_een_weg

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — a huge crowd of country people is packed together in a clearing under dark forest trees to hear a preacher, the preacher himself standing in a brown robe away at the back with his arm stretched out and his finger pointing off to the side, a man in red and a man in blue listening close beside him, the whole middle of the picture filled with heads in hats and hoods and white linen caps turned toward him, a man clinging up in the branches overhead to see over the others, more faces crowded in among the trunks, a fat pilgrim in a pale cloak with a scrip of badges sitting with his back to us in the foreground and other broad backs beside him, a red cloth hung on a branch at the left and the bark of a great tree filling the near corner, if anyone does not welcome you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that town, as a testimony against them, so they set out and went from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_sermon_of_saint_john_the_baptist

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Belshazzar's Feast — a king starts round from his own banquet table with his eyes wide and his mouth open under a heavy moustache, a great pale silk turban wound high on his head with a jewelled gold crown set into it and a dark tassel hanging at his ear, a stiff gold brocade mantle over his shoulders worked with pearls and coloured stones and a wide jewelled clasp at the breast, a long chain of gems with a pearl drop hanging down his chest, one arm flung out sideways and the other hand knocking against a gold dish on the table so that it tips, the cloth in front of him spread with silver plate and a bowl of dark grapes and a dropped knife, the hands of his startled guests coming in at the right edge and the rest of the hall lost in blackness, when herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening, he was perplexed, for some were saying that john had risen from the dead, others that elijah had appeared, and still others that a prophet of old had arisen
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_belshazzars_feast

pictures.scene: Droochsloot, A Village — a wide sandy village street opens out under a high grey sky of worked cloud, with a tall stone church tower and a long tiled roof standing up in the middle distance and low thatched and whitewashed cottages crowding along the right side, leafy trees breaking the roofline, and the whole street below filled with country people going about their day, women in white caps and red bodices talking together at the left, men in broad hats leaning on sticks, a boy with a black and white dog, figures sitting on the ground and standing in knots all the way back to a far crowd by the houses, i beheaded john, herod said, but who is this man i hear such things about, and he kept trying to see jesus, then the apostles returned and reported to jesus all that they had done, taking them away privately, he withdrew to a town called bethsaida
pictures.name: pd_droochsloot_dorp

pictures.scene: Kramskoi, Christ in the Wilderness — Christ sits alone on a low grey boulder in a wide stony desert at daybreak, wrapped in a heavy dark blue green mantle over a dull red robe, His bare feet set side by side on the broken rock, His hands locked hard together on His knees and His head bent forward in thought, His face drawn and hollow under tangled dark hair, with nothing around Him but shattered pale stone running back to a flat horizon and a quiet sky warming from grey to a long band of rose above the hills, but the crowds found out and followed him, he welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of god, and he healed those who needed healing, as the day neared its end, the twelve came to jesus and said, dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside for lodging and provisions, for we are in a desolate place here
pictures.name: pd_kramskoi_christ_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Millet, Woman Baking Bread — a countrywoman stands with her back to us in a dim stone bakehouse, a yellow kerchief tied over her hair and a pale green bodice over white sleeves rolled to the elbow, a long wide red sash knotted at her waist over a heavy brown skirt and a coarse apron, both hands gripping the shaft of a long wooden peel as she slides a flat round loaf into the low brick oven where the fire glows red along the edge of the opening, a rake leaning against the hearth and kindling scattered on the worn plank floor, but jesus told them, you give them something to eat, we have only five loaves of bread and two fish, they answered, unless we go and buy food for all these people, there were about five thousand men, he told his disciples, have them sit down in groups of about fifty each
pictures.name: pd_millet_brood

pictures.scene: Chardin, Grace Before the Meal — a mother in a white cap and a rust brown jacket over a long grey blue apron leans across a round table spread with a white cloth and sets a shallow dish down in front of her children, the elder girl seated in a tall striped armchair with her hands on the cloth and her eyes down, the smaller child kneeling on a low stool in a cream dress and a red cap with her little hands lifted and pressed together to say the blessing, a spoon and a plate and a dish of something hot on the table between them and a warming pan standing on the tiled floor, they did so, and everyone was seated, taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, jesus spoke a blessing and broke them, then he gave them to the disciples to set before the people
pictures.name: pd_chardin_benedicite

pictures.scene: El Greco, Saint Francis in Prayer — a friar kneels alone in the mouth of a dark rock cave in a coarse grey habit with the hood thrown back off his cropped black hair, his thin face lifted a little and turned aside in the one patch of cold light, one hand laid flat against his breast with the wound showing in the palm and the other drawn up inside the sleeve, a knotted cord belt hanging in a long loop down the front of the habit to the ground, a small carved crucifix standing on the rock shelf at his right and a spray of ivy hanging in from the dark above, they all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over, one day as jesus was praying in private and the disciples were with him, he questioned them, who do the crowds say i am
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_st_francis_in_prayer

pictures.scene: Bellini, Christ Blessing — Christ stands close to the viewer against an evening sky of blue and long grey cloud, a plaited crown of thorns pressed down over His dark hair with a thin gold halo of rays rising behind it, His face lit full on with the lips parted and the eyes looking steadily out and a little past us, a plain white robe banded with worked gold at the neck and the shoulders and the cuff, one hand lifted at the left in blessing and the other, pierced through the palm, holding a heavy black clasped book against His body, a small opening in the robe showing the wound in His side, and a low green country just visible at the bottom corner, they replied, some say john the baptist, others say elijah, and still others, that a prophet of old has arisen, but what about you, jesus asked, who do you say i am, peter answered, the christ of god
pictures.name: pd_bellini_blessing_christ

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, Sorrowing Old Man — a bald white haired working man sits hunched on a plain red wooden chair in the corner of a bare room, dressed from neck to ankle in worn blue, his elbows driven down onto his knees and both fists pressed hard against his eyes so that his whole face is hidden, his heavy nailed boots planted apart on a floor of raw yellow boards, a second chair and the edge of a fireplace behind him and nothing else in the room at all, jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone, the son of man must suffer many things, he said, he must be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_sorrowing_old_man

pictures.scene: Titian, Christ Carrying the Cross — Christ moves forward out of deep shadow under the long beam of the cross, the plaited crown of thorns pushed down into His hair with blood running from it, His face turned down and sideways in patient exhaustion, His shoulder bare where the pale robe has slipped and the great dark red timber laid across it, and behind Him at the left an old white bearded man leans in under the beam to take the weight, one ringed hand braced flat against the wood, the rest of the ground black around them, then jesus said to all of them, if anyone wants to come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me, for whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for my sake will save it
pictures.name: pd_titian_carrying_cross_simon

pictures.scene: Bosch, Death and the Miser — an old man in a long olive green gown and a green cap leans over an open money chest at the foot of a bed, a bunch of keys and a rosary hanging at his belt and a staff under his arm, dropping one more gold coin into a red purse that a small grey demon is holding up to him from inside the chest, while other little demons scuttle under the chest and clamber up the wall with letters and seals, and below on the step lie his discarded red and rose robes, a steel helmet, a lance and a long sword left where they fell, a pale hooded figure looking out over them, what does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet lose or forfeit his very self, if anyone is ashamed of me and my words, the son of man will be ashamed of him when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the father and of the holy angels
pictures.name: pd_bosch_death_and_the_miser

pictures.scene: Friedrich, The Cross in the Mountains — a tall dark crucifix stands planted on the very top of a rocky summit, turned away from us and tilted slightly back, with the small figure on it lit along one side by a sun that has already dropped out of sight behind the hill, a close stand of black fir trees crowding up the slope around the bare pink and rust coloured rocks, and the whole upper sky burning from deep violet grey down through orange cloud to a pale gold edge, with five long rays of light fanning up from behind the mountain, but i tell you truthfully, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of god, about eight days after jesus had said these things, he took with him peter, john, and james, and went up on a mountain to pray
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_cross_in_the_mountains

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Transfiguration — Christ stands high on the bare rock of the mountain inside a great white oval of light, His arms stretched straight out to either side, His face calm and full on under a gold halo crossed with three red bars, His hair and beard shining pale, the whole robe over Him turned to a soft white that is almost the colour of the light itself and falling in long quiet folds to His bare feet on the stone, and at the very bottom of the picture one apostle kneels with his back to us in a dull rose mantle, his gold rayed halo tipped forward as he shields his eyes, and as he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became radiantly white, suddenly two men, moses and elijah, began talking with jesus
pictures.name: pd_angelico_transfiguration

pictures.scene: Bellini, The Agony in the Garden — Christ kneels high on a bare ridge of pale earth at daybreak with His back to us, in a deep blue mantle over a red robe, His bare feet turned out behind Him and His hands lifted together towards a sky of blue and long grey cloud going pink along the horizon, and below Him on the slope two apostles lie fast asleep, one curled with his head on his arm in pale blue and one stretched out full length in a rose pink cloak with his face turned up and his mouth open, while far off across the valley a file of soldiers with spears and shields comes along the road towards them, they appeared in glory and spoke about his departure, which he was about to accomplish at jerusalem, meanwhile peter and his companions were overcome by sleep, but when they awoke, they saw jesus' glory and the two men standing with him
pictures.name: pd_bellini_gebed_in_de_hof_van_olijven

pictures.scene: Friedrich, Wanderer Above the Sea of Fog — a man stands with his back to us on the broken rocks of a summit, in a dark green coat with his fair hair blown about, one hand resting on a walking stick and the other on his hip, looking out over a whole country drowned in white cloud, with bare crags breaking up through it close by, wooded ridges and a far blue mountain rising out of it beyond, and the pale sky above barred with thin high cloud, as moses and elijah were leaving, peter said to jesus, master, it is good for us to be here, let us put up three shelters, one for you, one for moses, and one for elijah, he did not know what he was saying, while peter was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog

pictures.scene: Memling, Christ Blessing — the face of Christ fills the whole picture, turned straight out and looking directly at us, the long brown hair parted in the middle and falling past both shoulders, a thin beard and a quiet closed mouth, the eyes steady and unhurried, a broad disc of gold laid behind the head with fine rays cut into it and dark blue cloud showing around its edge, a deep red robe across the shoulders, and one hand raised in front of the breast with two fingers lifted in blessing while the other hand rests below, and a voice came from the cloud, saying, this is my son, whom i have chosen, listen to him, after the voice had spoken, only jesus was present with them, the disciples kept this to themselves, and in those days they did not tell anyone what they had seen
pictures.name: pd_memling_christ_blessing

pictures.scene: Repin, A Religious Procession in Kursk Province — a huge crowd of country people comes down a wide dusty road under a hazy pale sky, gold embroidered banners and a blue and white shrine carried high at the far end of it, priests in heavy gold vestments and officials in black among hundreds of heads packed close together, and out in front of them all a lame boy in a ragged grey coat drives himself forward on a crutch with his bad leg bound and his face lifted straight toward what he is pushing to reach, the next day, when they came down from the mountain, jesus was met by a large crowd, suddenly a man in the crowd cried out, teacher, i beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child
pictures.name: pd_repin_religious_procession_in_kursk_province

pictures.scene: Tidemand, The Sick Child — a mother in a pale embroidered bodice and a yellow headcloth sits at the side of a low cradle in a dark log room lit by one small lamp, her chin resting against her closed hand and her eyes fixed on the child lying wrapped in the cradle between them, while the father sits across from her in a red waistcoat with his arms folded tight and his head bent, both of them keeping watch and neither of them able to do anything, a spirit keeps seizing him, and he screams abruptly, it throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth, it keeps mauling him and rarely departs from him, i begged your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable
pictures.name: pd_tidemand_het_zieke_kind

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Jacob Blessing the Sons of Joseph — a very old man props himself up on a deep red bed in a white nightshirt and a soft cap, his thin white beard falling on his chest, and reaches a long pale hand out across the covers to lay it flat on the fair head of a boy who has bent down under it with his eyes closed and his hands crossed on his breast, while the boy's father steadies the old man from behind in a great pale turban and a second dark haired child looks up from the edge of the bed, o unbelieving and perverse generation, jesus replied, how long must i remain with you and put up with you, bring your son here, even while the boy was approaching, the demon slammed him to the ground in a convulsion, but jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_jacob_blessing_the_sons_of_joseph

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Taking of Christ — Christ stands pressed in at night with His eyes cast down and His brows drawn together, His hands locked and pushed low in front of Him, a heavy red cloak over His shoulder, while a bald bearded man leans right into His face from the side and a soldier in black polished armour throws an armoured arm across Him and takes hold of His throat, a disciple behind Him crying out with his mouth open and his arms flung up as he goes, and they were all astonished at the greatness of god, while everyone was marveling at all that jesus was doing, he said to his disciples, let these words sink into your ears, the son of man is about to be delivered into the hands of men
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_the_taking_of_christ

pictures.scene: Garofalo, Christ Washing the Disciples' Feet — Christ kneels right down on the floor in a red robe with a white cloth tied round His waist, a fine gold halo of rays about His head, and holds one of Peter's feet in the water of a shallow brass basin, while Peter sits above Him in a blue tunic with his white beard and his hand pressed flat to his own chest in protest, and a group of apostles behind them lean together watching and talking it over among themselves, but they did not understand this statement, it was veiled from them so that they could not comprehend it, and they were afraid to ask him about it, then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest
pictures.name: pd_garofalo_christ_washing_the_disciples_feet

pictures.scene: Anker, Two Children — two fair haired children stand together on a patterned carpet in front of a deep red armchair, the elder boy in a blue velvet suit with a wide pale blue bow at his collar, standing straight with one hand resting back on the arm of the chair and looking steadily out at us, and beside him, barely up to his shoulder, a much smaller child in a white lace dress with blue ribbons and pale blue stockings, holding a little toy elephant on a red string and smiling, but jesus, knowing the thoughts of their hearts, had a little child stand beside him, and he said to them, whoever welcomes this little child in my name welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me, for whoever is the least among all of you, he is the greatest
pictures.name: pd_anker_kinderen

pictures.scene: Dou, A Hermit at Prayer — an old man alone in a dim stone cell leans forward over a table with his bald head bent and his eyes lowered, a thin white beard on his chin and a coarse brown hooded habit on his shoulders, his two worn hands pressed palm to palm in front of his breast with a string of beads hanging down through the fingers, and a small carved crucifix and a book lying on the table at his elbow, master, said john, we saw someone driving out demons in your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us, do not stop him, jesus replied, for whoever is not against you is for you
pictures.name: pd_dou_kluizenaar_in_gebed

pictures.scene: Duccio, Christ and the Samaritan Woman — Christ sits on the low marble rim of a green and white well against a plain field of gold, in a deep blue mantle over a red brown robe with a thin gold halo ringing His head, one hand lifted open in front of Him as He speaks and the other resting on the stone, and across the well stands a Samaritan woman in a long pale gown and a white headcloth with a round clay jar balanced on her head and a rope bucket in her other hand, her near hand raised in answer, as the day of his ascension approached, jesus resolutely set out for jerusalem, he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a village of the samaritans to make arrangements for him
pictures.name: pd_duccio_christ_and_the_samaritan_woman

pictures.scene: Angeli, Elijah Taken Up in a Chariot of Fire — an old prophet with a long white beard is carried up off the ground in a great rush of rose coloured flame, his bare feet still showing at the edge of the fire and a heavy white mantle gathered up in both hands and billowing out around him, his head turned back and up over his shoulder, the golden wheel of the chariot burning beside him, and far below at the foot of the picture a dark bank of rock and a thin strip of pale water, but the people there refused to welcome him, because he was heading for jerusalem, when the disciples james and john saw this, they asked, lord, do you want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them
pictures.name: pd_angeli_elijah_taken_up_in_a_chariot_of_fire

pictures.scene: Corot, A Road — a broad pale road runs away from us over the crest of a rise and down into a wide hazy valley, a dark wall of summer trees banked along the right side of it and a single slender tree standing out against the sky on the left, the sky above full of soft moving cloud, and one lone traveller in a dark coat and a white cap walking away up the middle of the road with a bundle under the arm, already small against the distance, but jesus turned and rebuked them, and he and his disciples went on to another village
pictures.name: pd_corot_road

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Beggars — two crippled men in patched white and grey tunics stand on the grass outside a brick wall, both of them propped up on rough wooden crutches with their legs gone at the knee and their stumps strapped into leather pads, one turning his lined face up and open mouthed toward whoever is passing, the other with his back to us and his crutches planted wide, and behind them a woman in a long black cloak and a wide hat walks away holding out an empty begging bowl, as they were walking along the road, someone said to jesus, i will follow you wherever you go, jesus replied, foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the son of man has no place to lay his head
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_beggars

pictures.scene: Carracci, The Holy Women at the Tomb — a woman in a blue veil and mantle over a red gown stands barefoot at the edge of an open grave early in the morning, one hand thrown up flat in alarm and the other pressed against her breast, her face turned sharply toward what she has just been told, while a second woman in a heavy grey white cloak over a green gown pushes forward past her and reaches a bare arm down toward the empty tomb, more women crowding in behind at the right, then he said to another man, follow me, the man replied, lord, first let me go and bury my father, but jesus told him, let the dead bury their own dead, you, however, go and proclaim the kingdom of god
pictures.name: pd_carracci_holy_women_at_the_tomb

pictures.scene: Bonheur, Ploughing in the Nivernais — a team of heavy pale oxen hauls a plough up a long field under a clear morning sky, their heads down in the wooden yokes and bands of straw tied round their horns, the broken earth turned up in great wet clods across the whole foreground, and the ploughman walking at their shoulder in a blue smock and a broad straw hat with his goad held high, looking forward along the furrow and not back, still another said, i will follow you, lord, but first let me bid farewell to my family, then jesus declared, no one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of god
pictures.name: pd_bonheur_ploughing_in_the_nivernais

lines.text: Then Jesus called the Twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and power to cure diseases.
And He sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
Take nothing for the journey, He told them, no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic.
Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that area.
If anyone does not welcome you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that town, as a testimony against them.
So they set out and went from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.
When Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening, he was perplexed. For some were saying that John had risen from the dead,
others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that a prophet of old had arisen.
I beheaded John, Herod said, but who is this man I hear such things about? And he kept trying to see Jesus.
Then the apostles returned and reported to Jesus all that they had done. Taking them away privately, He withdrew to a town called Bethsaida.
But the crowds found out and followed Him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and He healed those who needed healing.

As the day neared its end, the Twelve came to Jesus and said, Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside for lodging and provisions. For we are in a desolate place here.
But Jesus told them, You give them something to eat. We have only five loaves of bread and two fish, they answered, unless we go and buy food for all these people.
There were about five thousand men. He told His disciples, Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.
They did so, and everyone was seated.
Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, Jesus spoke a blessing and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples to set before the people.
They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
One day as Jesus was praying in private and the disciples were with Him, He questioned them: Who do the crowds say I am?
They replied, Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that a prophet of old has arisen.
But what about you? Jesus asked. Who do you say I am? Peter answered, The Christ of God.
Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.
The Son of Man must suffer many things, He said. He must be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
Then Jesus said to all of them, If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.
For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.
What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet lose or forfeit his very self?
If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
But I tell you truthfully, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.
About eight days after Jesus had said these things, He took with Him Peter, John, and James, and went up on a mountain to pray.
And as He was praying, the appearance of His face changed, and His clothes became radiantly white.
Suddenly two men, Moses and Elijah, began talking with Jesus.
They appeared in glory and spoke about His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
Meanwhile Peter and his companions were overcome by sleep, but when they awoke, they saw Jesus' glory and the two men standing with Him.

As Moses and Elijah were leaving, Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters, one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah. He did not know what he was saying.
While Peter was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
And a voice came from the cloud, saying, This is My Son, whom I have chosen. Listen to Him!
After the voice had spoken, only Jesus was present with them. The disciples kept this to themselves, and in those days they did not tell anyone what they had seen.
The next day, when they came down from the mountain, Jesus was met by a large crowd.
Suddenly a man in the crowd cried out, Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, for he is my only child.
A spirit keeps seizing him, and he screams abruptly. It throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It keeps mauling him and rarely departs from him.
I begged Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.
O unbelieving and perverse generation! Jesus replied. How long must I remain with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.
Even while the boy was approaching, the demon slammed him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
And they were all astonished at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus was doing, He said to His disciples,
Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.
But they did not understand this statement. It was veiled from them so that they could not comprehend it, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.
Then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
But Jesus, knowing the thoughts of their hearts, had a little child stand beside Him.
And He said to them, Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me. For whoever is the least among all of you, he is the greatest.
Master, said John, we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.
Do not stop him, Jesus replied, for whoever is not against you is for you.
As the day of His ascension approached, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.
He sent messengers on ahead, who went into a village of the Samaritans to make arrangements for Him.
But the people there refused to welcome Him, because He was heading for Jerusalem.
When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, Lord, do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them?
But Jesus turned and rebuked them.
And He and His disciples went on to another village.
As they were walking along the road, someone said to Jesus, I will follow You wherever You go.
Jesus replied, Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
Then He said to another man, Follow Me. The man replied, Lord, first let me go and bury my father.
But Jesus told him, Let the dead bury their own dead. You, however, go and proclaim the kingdom of God.
Still another said, I will follow You, Lord; but first let me bid farewell to my family.
Then Jesus declared, No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.
